newsitem.title: HONDURAS: Claudia Schiffer builds Honduras mansion - reports.
newsitem.headline: Claudia Schiffer builds Honduras mansion - reports.

text.p: German supermodel Claudia Schiffer has built a mansion on the Honduran island of Roatan, local media said on Thursday.

National newspapers said Schiffer spent $2 million for a new home on one of the exclusive Bay Islands off the Caribbean coast of Honduras. Local media also reported Schiffer and her husband, magician David Copperfield, would soon throw a party to open the house. The guest list was reported to include Hollywood stars Richard Gere and George Hamilton.
But Roatan Mayor Ricardo Merren was highly sceptical, the reports said. "It's not true. We all know each other here, and we would know if it were true," Merren was quoted as saying.
